svg.title: SQLite database and Google Sheets schema, hand-arranged grid with orthogonal routed connectors
svg.desc: Every SQLite table and every Google Sheets tab in a single hand-placed grid, grouped into three highlighted zones. Relationship lines are routed around cards (never through them) as rounded orthogonal paths, spread apart from each other.
svg.text: Gray = SQLite table · Blue = Control Sheet (one, shared) · Green = Per-hub Sheet (one per hub) · Bold field = primary/unique key
